module: Table of texts (labels, section titles, tooltips) in English for the rally editor's "AI Competitors" tab. No code: the module only contains strings read by aiCompetitorsTab and aiCompetitorsEditorPlot. Useful to find the meaning of each of the 26 general parameters of the model and of a competitor's traits.
notes: In the UI, the model's "skill" trait is presented under the name "Pace" (driverTraitTooltips.Pace).
The reference time is, according to the help text, replaced in game by the "silver" bar time.

playerReferenceHelp.desc: Help for the stage reference time (seconds), the basis of the model and the preview.

driverTraitTooltips.desc: Tooltips for the Pace, Consistency, Risk traits.

generalGroupPresentation.desc: Title and description of the 6 general parameter groups (same order as the model's generalParamGroups).

generalParamLabels.desc: Displayed label of each general parameter (key = snake_case name).

outcomeLabels.desc: Short labels of the 5 outcomes: Clean, Push, Minor incident, Major incident, DNF.

competitorNavigationTooltip.desc: Tooltip of the competitor selector (saving writes the whole list).

chart.desc: Chart texts: title, subtitle, legendHint, axisLabel, plotTooSmall.

previewSection.desc: Title and subtitle of the Preview section.

globalSection.desc: Title and subtitle of the Global parameters section.

referenceSection.desc: Texts of the reference time and drivers section (title, subtitle, referenceTimeLabel).

driverPreviewSection.desc: Texts of the Driver preview section (title, subtitle, emptyCompetitors).

toolbar.desc: Toolbar texts: header, configPathPrefix, reload, save.
